ch.title: 更新说明
content: 应用图标完整显示原始机器人图案，不再放大或裁剪。
Android、iOS 和 PWA 启用统一黄底启动画面。
修复切换后台后持续显示“正在重连”及界面按钮无响应的问题。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Shows the complete original robot artwork without launcher-icon zooming or cropping.
Adds the approved amber launch screen across Android, iOS, and the PWA.
Fixes stuck reconnecting indicators and unresponsive controls after returning from the background.
